div.div: The existing retimer wiring and output labels are consistent with positive divider delay and the rising-edge convention above.

div.div: For each raw edge, measure δ from its nominal launching ph edge to D at the retimer. Require δ_min > t_hold and δ_max + t_setup < 3 UI.

div.div: Include relative clock skew and jitter in these bounds. Even-numbered outputs capture after 4 UI; odd-numbered outputs capture after 3 UI.
